reviewer_status: AI research agent; not an independent licensed legal reviewer
overall: The principal boundaries are accurate: synthetic technical work, unknown professional acceptance, no commercial or self-financing success, current Ontario authority with exceptions, and no comprehensive deployment opinion. Six concise clarifications are recommended below.

corrections.find: The packet displays the exact insertion and both complete source documents.
corrections.replace: The packet displays the deleted and added text in that replacement, together with both complete source documents.
corrections.reason: RECON-01 changes an existing sentence fragment, removing text as well as adding proof-of-concept use. Calling it only an insertion understates the actual edit.

corrections.location: First prototype, after sentence identifying PRIMARY-17 and PRIMARY-20
corrections.insert_after: However, B, C1 and C accepted only PRIMARY-17 and PRIMARY-20 as complete primary packets.
corrections.insert: These two technical passes include correctly reported absences and unresolved terms: acceptance means that the support packet matches the declared key and surfaces its review questions, not that the agreement is complete, legally acceptable or ready to sign.
corrections.reason: The only accepted primary packets concern missing provisions or uncertainty. Make their accepted support boundary explicit, rather than letting readers infer resolved substantive review.

corrections.find: Participants worked across conditions; three legally experienced coauthors graded anonymized work on five seven-point dimensions, and time was self-reported. Productivity combined quality with the fraction of allotted time.
corrections.replace: Randomized stable groups assigned two tasks per condition. Three coauthors with legal practice experience graded work blind to condition and participant identity on five seven-point dimensions; time was self-reported. Productivity divided the sum of quality scores by the fraction of allotted time used.
corrections.reason: States randomization, actual grading blindness and metric definition precisely. Counts, dates, lack of significant NDA improvement and limits elsewhere are correct.

corrections.replace: First prototype; 2/24 complete technical passes; service unqualified.
corrections.reason: Avoids implying zero technical passes while retaining the negative service conclusion.

corrections.find: Le contrôle complet du premier prototype n’a accepté que 2 dossiers sur 24 pour les méthodes B, C1 et C.
corrections.replace: Seuls 2 dossiers sur 24 ont satisfait à l’ensemble des critères techniques du premier prototype pour les méthodes B, C1 et C.
corrections.reason: Natural French that explicitly distinguishes technical acceptance from professional acceptance.

corrections.find: Aucun des 216 scénarios de réinvestissement n’a financé une nouvelle capacité à partir d’un surplus d’exploitation.
corrections.replace: Aucune des 216 réalisations simulées n’a financé une première ou une deuxième capacité à partir d’un surplus d’exploitation.
corrections.reason: The design has nine scenarios and 24 paired worlds per scenario. Avoid describing all 216 as distinct scenario specifications.

verified_without_requested_change: Current e-Laws reference is the canonical /90l08 page, with statutory/by-law exceptions and licence scope retained.
LSO April 2024 guidance is identified by document date and current retrieval date; human verification and professional responsibility are preserved.
External study enrollment/completion counts, October 2024 field period and lack of significant NDA-task benefit are accurate.
Primary-09/10 explanations match the authored definitions and cross-reference quantities.
RECON-07/08 each contain two separate amendments; RECON-09/10 preserve genuine Unicode and formatting distinctions.
Spellbook documentation date August 28, 2026 verified on the official help page during review.
French interface appropriately does not translate or replace the frozen English contract corpus.
No professional correctness, intended-meaning preservation, actual buyer delivery or operating-funded capability success is asserted as established.
limits: This is claim-boundary and language review, not legal certification.
Economic arithmetic, native implementation, rendering and repository publication qualification are outside this review.
